# Accessibility Statement

ZeroLabz is committed to ensuring our QuantumEdge network visualizers and AI Studio interfaces are accessible to all users.

## Supported Environments
- The frontend UI supports standard browser high-contrast modes and keyboard navigation principles.
- Code blocks and telemetry outputs are optimized for screen readers.

## Reporting Issues
If you encounter any accessibility barriers within our interfaces, please report them to **dev@zrolabz.com**.
